messages.subject: Porting analysis from mm10 to GRCm39
messages.subject_clean: Porting analysis from mm10 to GRCm39
messages.body_plain: This might be a very naive question, but what is the best way to convert a cross object that was originally created with mm10 GM marker positions to GRCm39?
messages.body_snippet: This might be a very naive question, but what is the best way to convert a cross object that was originally created with mm10 GM marker positions to GRCm39?

messages.subject: Re: Porting analysis from mm10 to GRCm39
messages.subject_clean: Porting analysis from mm10 to GRCm39
messages.body_plain:
The mmconvert package <https://cran.r-project.org/package=mmconvert> has a function cross2_to_grcm39() <https://search.r-project.org/CRAN/refmans/mmconvert/html/cross2_to_grcm39.html> to do exactly this, in cases where the genotypes are from GigaMUGA or MegaMUGA arrays.

karl
